title: Email: Prairie Table Permit Pull

fields.subject: Prairie Table permit pull
fields.body:
Pulled the file.

Prairie Table Catering, owner Delphine Okonkwo (555-0166). License current. Last routine inspection 06/2026: one priority item for cold-holding temperatures, corrected on site. Report attached.

Called the shop at 09:10 for the event menu. Delphine Okonkwo read it back the same as the committee's list: roast pork loin, chicken thighs, mashed potatoes, coleslaw, pasta salad, green beans, rolls, fruit cobbler, sheet cake. She says they still have about 3 quarts of leftover coleslaw and one hotel pan of pasta salad in the walk-in from Saturday. The chicken was all served.

She also mentioned they're "slammed tomorrow": Tuesday 11:30, about 85 boxed lunches for the senior meal. Prep starts tonight with the same crew and the same Kessler produce order.

No files yet on the Dunmore baker or the Kessler vendor.
fields.signature:
Environmental Health Specialist
Environmental Health | Marlow County Health Department
Main line 555-0100

instructorNote: This is a core inject. It shows that suspect leftovers still exist and that the caterer serves a senior meal on Tuesday at 11:30. Watch for the EHS to: phone the operator and ask for a voluntary hold on the coleslaw and pasta salad, logging the request and reply times; collect samples with chain-of-custody and cold-chain records; ask about ill food handlers; pull the baker and Kessler files; and brief the Director that an embargo or closure before tonight's prep needs the Director's signature.
